explication: MCP for Blender connects an AI client to Blender through an MCP server and a Blender-hosted socket addon. The main workflow is a client tool request, server-side tool handling, socket command execution in Blender, and a result returned to the client. Documented capabilities include scene/object/material manipulation, inspection, code execution, and external asset/model generation. Setup, consent and privacy telemetry, app extensions, and trajectory capture are supporting runtime branches. Several feature-specific server internals are unsampled, so capability details rely on the README rather than inferred call chains.
